declarations.name: cpu_profile
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) : view.setup.profile.verify = false ∧ view.setup.profile.gpu = false

declarations.name: native_stride_profile
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) : view.nativeStride = (if resolved.slotData.metadata.isPacked then memProfile.packedWords else memProfile.unpackedWords)

declarations.name: nativeAddress
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) (row : view.Index) (word : Fin view.nativeStride) : Fin resolved.slotData.trace.size

declarations.name: actual_l1
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) (row : view.Index) : view.l1? row = some (if row.val = 0 then 1 else 0)

declarations.name: same_native_fixed_buffer
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) (row : view.Index) : readWord? (resolved.params false) .fixed (row.val * view.setup.nConstants + 1) = view.l1? row

declarations.name: native_current_row
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) (row : view.Index) : view.setup.baseRow? row.val 0 = some row.val

declarations.name: native_next_row
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) (row : view.Index) : view.setup.baseRow? row.val 1 = some (view.next row).val

declarations.name: shifted_l1
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) (row : view.Index) : view.l1? (view.next row) = some (if row.val + 1 = view.count then 1 else 0)

declarations.name: unique_physical_last
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) : ∃! row : view.Index, view.l1? (view.next row) = some 1

declarations.name: joint_source_buffers
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) : NativeValuesLayout.groupWords? .mem (resolved.params false) = some view.groupWords ∧ directBatch? resolved = some view.directWords ∧ (resolved.params false).trace = resolved.slotData.trace ∧ (resolved.params false).airgroupValues = resolved.slotData.airgroupValues ∧ (resolved.params false).airvalues = resolved.slotData.airvalues

declarations.name: native_rotation
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) (row : view.Index) (rotation : Int) : view.setup.baseRow? row.val rotation = some (view.rotate row rotation).val

declarations.name: rotate_zero
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) (row : view.Index) : view.rotate row 0 = row

declarations.name: rotate_one
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) (row : view.Index) : view.rotate row 1 = view.next row

declarations.name: native_previous
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) (row : view.Index) : view.setup.baseRow? row.val (-1) = some (view.previous row).val

declarations.name: previous_of_positive
declarations.type_signature: (view : View resolved) (row : view.Index) (positive : 0 < row.val) : (view.previous row).val = row.val - 1
